name: Standing Dumbbell Bicep Curl
description: Classic standing bicep curl building peak and arm mass.
setup: Stand tall with dumbbells at sides, palms forward.
execution: Curl both dumbbells up by flexing elbows, squeeze at top, lower under control.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
description: Neutral-grip curl targeting brachialis and brachioradialis for thicker arms.
setup: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing each other.
execution: Curl maintaining neutral grip, squeeze at top, lower slowly.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower
form_cues: Palms face each other whole rep
progression: Cross-body hammer curl or heavier weight

name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
description: Strict isolation curl maximizing bicep peak contraction.
setup: Sit on bench, brace elbow against inner thigh, dumbbell between feet.
execution: Curl dumbbell to shoulder, squeeze hard at top, lower with full control.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower
common_mistakes: Using a weight that is too heavy

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Incline-bench curl stretching the long head of the biceps for full development.
setup: Set bench to 45 degrees, sit back, arms hanging straight down.
execution: Curl dumbbells up keeping upper arms stationary, squeeze, lower with stretch.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
description: Supported curl eliminating momentum for strict bicep isolation.
setup: Set bench to near vertical. Lean chest against the backrest with arm draped over the top.
execution: Curl dumbbell to shoulder, squeeze, lower to full extension.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Reverse Curl
description: Overhand-grip curl targeting the brachioradialis and forearm extensors.
setup: Stand with dumbbells using overhand grip, arms at sides.
execution: Curl dumbbells up maintaining pronated grip, lower slowly.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower
progression: Heavy hammer curls or Zottman curls

name: Dumbbell Zottman Curl
description: Combination curl: supinated up, pronated down, hitting all forearm and bicep heads.
setup: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms forward.
execution: Curl up with supinated grip, rotate to pronated at top, lower slowly with overhand grip.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower
form_cues: Rotate at the top not mid-rep
progression: Heavier weight or pause at top

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
description: Unilateral hammer curl crossing the body to emphasize the brachialis peak.
setup: Stand with dumbbell in one hand at side.
execution: Curl dumbbell across torso toward opposite shoulder, squeeze, lower slowly.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower
common_mistakes: Curling straight up instead of across
progression: Heavier weight or add pause at top

name: Dumbbell Spider Curl
description: Chest-supported curl over incline bench eliminating all momentum.
setup: Lie face-down on incline bench, arms hanging straight down holding dumbbells.
execution: Curl dumbbells to forehead, squeeze biceps hard, lower with full control.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Wrist Curl
description: Wrist flexion exercise building forearm mass and grip endurance.
setup: Kneel beside bench, forearms on surface, palms up, wrists hanging off edge.
execution: Curl wrists up as high as possible, squeeze, lower to full stretch.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
description: Wrist extension exercise targeting the forearm extensors for balanced development.
setup: Kneel beside bench, forearms on surface, palms down, wrists hanging off edge.
execution: Extend wrists up, pause at top, lower to full flexion.
breathing: Exhale on lift, inhale on lower
progression: Add weight or pause at top

name: Dumbbell Isometric Bicep Hold
description: Isometric hold at 90 degrees building bicep endurance and time under tension.
setup: Stand with dumbbells, curl to 90 degrees.
execution: Hold the 90-degree position for the prescribed time while maintaining tight bicep contraction.

name: Dumbbell Pinwheel Curl
description: Curling the dumbbell across the body in a pinwheel motion for brachialis emphasis.
setup: Stand with dumbbell in one hand at side.
execution: Curl dumbbell across body to opposite shoulder in smooth arc, lower under control.
breathing: Exhale on curl, inhale on lower

name: Dumbbell Shrug to Curl
description: Combination movement pairing a shrug with a curl for arms and traps.
execution: Shrug shoulders up, then without lowering curl the dumbbells to shoulders, lower both together.
breathing: Inhale shrug, exhale curl, inhale lower
